relations.evidence: The Payment Gateway consists of the following key components: - **Checkout API**: Handles incoming payment requests from customers.
The Payment Gateway consists of the following key components: - **Tokenization Service**: Secures sensitive payment information by converting it into a token.
The Payment Gateway consists of the following key components: - **Payment Router**: Directs payment requests to the appropriate processing entities.
The Payment Gateway consists of the following key components: - **Settlement Batch Job**: Executes daily settlement processes for completed transactions.
